newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BRIGHTON WIN VOTE TO STAY IN ENGLISH LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRIGHTON WIN VOTE TO STAY IN ENGLISH LEAGUE.

text.p: Brighton retained their English Football League status on Thursday after a ballot at an extraordinary general meeting of clubs.
"Brighton have not been expelled," a League spokeswoman said. Seventeen of the 72 clubs had voted to expel the third division club, but 47 opposed the move. Eight clubs abstained.
Brighton had faced exclusion from the League after 77 years as members by failing to pay a 500,000 pounds ($837,000) bond to guarantee their continued presence next season.
They saved their place in the third division last season by drawing at Hereford on the last day of the season. Hereford were relegated on goal difference.
Brighton are sharing a ground with Gillingham after leaving their Goldstone ground last season.
